chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 In the beginning was the gospel preached through the Son. And the gospel was the word, and the word was with the Son, and the Son was with God, and the Son was of God. VerseEnd Verse2 The same was in the beginning with God. VerseEnd Verse3 All things were made by him, and without him was not anything made which was made. VerseEnd Verse4 In him was the gospel, and the gospel was the life, and the life was the light of men. VerseEnd Verse5 And the light shines in the world, and the world perceives it not. VerseEnd

Verse6 There was a man sent from God whose name was John. VerseEnd Verse7 The same came into the world for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, to bear record of the gospel through the Son unto all, that through him men might believe. VerseEnd Verse8 He was not that Light, but came to bear witness of that Light, VerseEnd Verse9 who was the true Light who lights every man who comes into the world, even the Son of God, VerseEnd Verse10 he who was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not. VerseEnd Verse11 He came unto his own, and his own received him not. VerseEnd Verse12 But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God — only to them who believe on his name. VerseEnd Verse13 He was born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God. VerseEnd Verse14 And the same Word was made flesh and dwelled among us. And we beheld his glory, the glory as of the Only Begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth. VerseEnd

Verse15 John bore witness of him and cried, saying, This is he of whom I spoke. He who comes after me is preferred before me, for he was before me. VerseEnd Verse16 For in the beginning was the Word, even the Son, who is made flesh and sent unto us by the will of the Father. And as many as believe on his name shall receive of his fullness. And of his fullness have we all received, even immortality and eternal life through his grace. VerseEnd Verse17 For the law was given through Moses, but life and truth came through Jesus Christ. VerseEnd Verse18 For the law was after a carnal commandment, to the administration of death, but the gospel was after the power of an endless life through Jesus Christ, the Only Begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father. And no man has seen God at any time, except he has borne record of the Son, for except it is through him, no man can be saved. VerseEnd

Verse19 This is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you? VerseEnd Verse20 And he confessed and denied not that he was Elias, but confessed, saying, I am not the Christ. VerseEnd Verse21 And they asked him, saying, How then are you Elias? And he said, I am not that Elias who was to restore all things. And they asked him, saying, Are you that prophet? And he answered, No. VerseEnd Verse22 Then said they unto him, Who are you? — that we may give an answer to them who sent us. What do you say of yourself? VerseEnd Verse23 He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness: Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Isaiah. VerseEnd Verse24 And they who were sent were of the Pharisees. VerseEnd Verse25 And they asked him and said unto him, Why do you baptize then, if you are not the Christ, nor Elias who was to restore all things, neither that prophet? VerseEnd Verse26 John answered them, saying, I baptize with water, but there stands one among you whom you know not. VerseEnd Verse27 He it is of whom I bear record. He is that Prophet, even Elias, who, coming after me, is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to untie, VerseEnd or whose place I am not able to fill. For he shall baptize not only with water, but with fire, and with the holy ghost.

Verse29 The next day, John sees Jesus coming unto him, and said, Behold the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. VerseEnd Verse30 And John bore record of him unto the people, saying, This is he of whom I said, After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me, VerseEnd Verse31 and I knew him, and that he should be made manifest to Israel. Therefore have I come baptizing with water. VerseEnd Verse32 And John bore record, saying, When he was baptized of me, I saw the spirit descending from Heaven like a dove, and it abided upon him. VerseEnd Verse33 And I knew him, for he who sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom you shall see the spirit descending and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes with the holy ghost. VerseEnd Verse34 And I saw and bore record that this is the Son of God. VerseEnd Verse28 These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing. VerseEnd

Verse35 Again the next day after, John stood, and two of his disciples, VerseEnd Verse36 and looking upon Jesus as he walked, he said, Behold the Lamb of God. VerseEnd Verse37 And the two disciples heard him speak and they followed Jesus. VerseEnd Verse38 Then Jesus turned and saw them following him and said unto them, What do you seek? They said unto him, Rabbi — which is to say (being interpreted), Master — where do you dwell? VerseEnd Verse39 He says unto them, Come and see. And they came and saw where he dwelled, and abided with him that day, for it was about the tenth hour. VerseEnd Verse40 One of the two who heard John and followed Jesus was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother. VerseEnd Verse41 He first finds his own brother Simon, and said unto him, We have found the Messiah — which is (being interpreted) the Christ. VerseEnd Verse42 And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas — which is (by interpretation) a seer, or a stone. VerseEnd And they were fishermen. And they immediately left all and followed Jesus.

Verse43 The day following, Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and found Philip, and said unto him, Follow me. VerseEnd Verse44 Now Philip was at Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter. VerseEnd Verse45 Philip found Nathanael, and said unto him, We have found him of whom Moses, in the law and the prophets, did write — Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph. VerseEnd Verse46 And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip said unto him, Come and see. VerseEnd Verse47 Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him and said of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile. VerseEnd Verse48 Nathanael said unto him, From where do you know me? Jesus answering said unto him, Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you. VerseEnd Verse49 Nathanael answered and said unto him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God. You are the king of Israel. VerseEnd Verse50 Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, you believe? You shall see greater things than these. VerseEnd Verse51 And he said unto him, Truly, truly I say unto you, Hereafter you shall see Heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man. VerseEnd

LEChapter2 Verse1 And on the third day of the week, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there. VerseEnd Verse2 And Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage. VerseEnd Verse3 And when they lacked wine, his mother said unto him, They have no wine. VerseEnd Verse4 Jesus said unto her, Woman, what will you have me to do for you? That will I do, for my hour has not yet come. VerseEnd Verse5 His mother said unto the servants, Whatever he says unto you, see that you do it. VerseEnd Verse6 There were set there six waterpots of stone after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. VerseEnd Verse7 Jesus said unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim. VerseEnd Verse8 And he said, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bore unto him. VerseEnd Verse9 When the governor of the feast had tasted the water which was made wine (he knew not from where it was, but the servants who drew the water knew), the governor of the feast called the bridegroom VerseEnd Verse10 and said unto him, Every man at the beginning does set forth good wine, and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse. But you have kept the good wine until now. VerseEnd Verse11 This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and the faith of his disciples was strengthened in him. VerseEnd

Verse12 After this, he went down to Capernaum — he and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples. And they continued there not many days. VerseEnd Verse13 And the Jews’ Passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem VerseEnd Verse14 and found in the temple those who sold oxen, and sheep, and doves, and changers of money, sitting. VerseEnd Verse15 And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen, and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables. VerseEnd Verse16 And he said unto them who sold doves, Take these things from here. Make not my Father’s house a house of merchandise. VerseEnd Verse17 And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of your house has eaten me up. VerseEnd

Verse18 Then spoke the Jews and said unto him, What sign do you show unto us, seeing you do these things? VerseEnd Verse19 Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple and in three days I will raise it up. VerseEnd Verse20 Then said the Jews, Forty-six years was this temple in building, and will you rear it up in three days? VerseEnd Verse21 But he spoke of the temple of his body; VerseEnd Verse22 when therefore he had risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them, and they remembered the scripture and the word which Jesus had said unto them. VerseEnd Verse23 Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover on the feast day, many believed on his name when they saw the miracles which he did. VerseEnd Verse24 But Jesus did not commit himself unto them because he knew all things VerseEnd Verse25 and needed not that any should testify of man, for he knew what was in man. VerseEnd
